title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS
summary: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now generally available on AWS, giving enterprises a new path to build with OpenAI through the AWS environments, controls, and procurement workflows they already use. Customers can get started with OpenAI on AWS and move faster from evaluation to production.
body: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now generally available on AWS, giving enterprises a new path to build with OpenAI through the AWS environments, controls, and procurement workflows they already use. Customers can get started with OpenAI on AWS and move faster from evaluation to production.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布其前沿大模型及Codex编程工具已在亚马逊云科技（AWS）上全面可用。此举使得企业用户能够通过原有的AWS云环境、安全控制和采购工作流直接调用OpenAI技术，从而显著加速从模型评估到生产落地的业务转化周期。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI前沿模型与Codex正式登陆AWS，为企业级客户提供了更便捷的云端部署与采购通道。

glossary.explanationZh: 指处于行业最前沿、能力最强的高性能大语言与多模态基础模型。
OpenAI推出的用于代码生成与辅助软件工程的专用大模型系列。
亚马逊旗下的云计算服务平台，提供广泛的全球云基础设施和企业级服务。
